goal: Reject fee bump requests whose original change index points to an output without a destination
Prevent wallet users from silently losing outputs such as OP_RETURN data when bumping fees
reviewability: No open blockers or invalidating changes
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Concept approval to prevent silently dropping OP_RETURN outputs during fee bumps (rustaceanrob)
Verified by testing rejection of OP_RETURN change indices in fee bump tests on arm64 (cyb3ralbert)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it addresses a narrow edge case where an explicit RPC parameter dropped outputs
The bug fix only affects callers misidentifying outputs like OP_RETURN as change
It also refactors internal fee bump return structures to ease future wallet work
